purpose: One five-event contract shared by the generated browser client, the Python aggregate collector and the authorized report importer. Production collection is disabled; no observed campaign counts are claimed.
why_nothing_is_sending: GitHub Pages is a static host; a persistent same-origin event runtime is not deployed. Local tests do not create one.
The runtime, privacy/retention notice, host/proxy logging policy and end-to-end production receipt have not been approved or verified.
A selected tracking ID is recorded, but the account and per-product enrolled-Associates destination/report checks remain unconfirmed.
No authorized Associates Central aggregate report has been supplied. Clicks alone cannot establish orders or revenue.

implementation.client: analytics/client.js is the sole browser source. build.py copies it to assets/analytics.js and emits it on canonical reader pages only after both configuration switches and all deployment gates agree.
implementation.switch: data/config.json analytics and data/analytics-plan.json collection must agree. One-sided enablement fails the build, rather than changing the privacy text without loading the client.
implementation.endpoint_source: analytics/collector.py: a self-hosted same-origin JSON endpoint with exact origin, schema, size and page/product allowlists, no HTTP access log, and atomic UTC-day SQLite aggregates. Legacy PHP/Worker sources return 410 and never store events.
implementation.guard: Build checks reject mismatched definitions, config switches, unsafe routes, unapproved deployment or storage/identification APIs. DNT/GPC remain honoured at request time.
implementation.verification: Python tests exercise the HTTP route, storage schema, concurrency and report import. Node tests execute the generated browser script and validate its actual requests against the collector schema. Tests use isolated temporary data only.
implementation.what_is_not_shipped: No persistent hosted service, production event receipt, Search Console access or Associates report is available. Live collection stays off; the campaign ledger remains empty.

privacy_rules: Only event, canonical page_id, allow-listed target_id and the fixed 60s engagement bucket are permitted, with event-specific fields. Unknown fields are rejected, not silently retained.
The server adds the UTC day and increments a daily aggregate. It keeps no raw event stream, exact event timestamp, IP address, user agent, URL, referrer, cookie or persistent reader ID.
fetch uses credentials omit and referrerPolicy no-referrer; no beacon fallback can accidentally attach cookies. Cross-origin endpoints are refused. DNT and Global Privacy Control suppress requests.
The collector does not prevent the receiving host from seeing connection metadata. Review host and proxy logs and the applicable privacy/retention requirements before enabling it.

Only trusted primary or middle-button reader activations of an allow-listed Amazon host are observed. Measurement never prevents, wraps, redirects or automatically opens a product link. Counts can still be forged at the network level; they are not certified human sessions.

events.name: page_view
events.fires_when: Once per document when a canonical reader page first becomes visible, only after explicit collection enablement and absent DNT or Global Privacy Control.
events.note: Daily accepted-event counts only. Not unique people, eligible sessions, Amazon attribution or conversions.

events.name: outbound_click
events.fires_when: A trusted primary- or middle-button reader activation of a tagged, allow-listed Amazon destination; record the site product slug, never guess an ASIN or tracking ID.
events.note: Daily accepted-event counts only. Not unique people, eligible sessions, Amazon attribution or conversions.

events.name: article_engagement
events.fires_when: A published article or buying guide remains visible and active for the 60-second coarse threshold.
events.note: Daily accepted-event counts only. Not unique people, eligible sessions, Amazon attribution or conversions.

events.name: comparison_interaction
events.fires_when: A trusted activation opens an internal product-guide link from the comparison page; table visibility alone is not an interaction.
events.note: Daily accepted-event counts only. Not unique people, eligible sessions, Amazon attribution or conversions.

events.name: affiliate_report_import
events.fires_when: An authorized Associates Central report is imported; the corresponding aggregate is added to data/campaign-ledger.json.
events.note: Authorized aggregate import only; never accepted by the browser collector.

campaign_ledger.note: Empty until an authorized first-party report is obtained. Each imported aggregate preserves its timestamp, provenance label, channel and date range. Unreported fields stay blank.
campaign_ledger.why_empty: No authorized report has been obtained. Browser page views are not eligible sessions, and outbound clicks are not reported orders. Test fixtures never enter this ledger.

prerequisites.owner_action: Choose and deploy a persistent same-origin collector runtime; verify host/proxy logging and the privacy notice.
prerequisites.why: Static GitHub Pages cannot execute the collector. Hosting or account authorization cannot be fabricated.

prerequisites.owner_action: Confirm one production aggregate receipt, then enable both switches with all recorded deployment gates in one change.
prerequisites.why: The build rejects one-sided switches and incompatible event definitions.

prerequisites.owner_action: Confirm shopnow047c-20 and the intended listing for each submitted link in the enrolled workflow, test attribution in authorized reports, and import dated report aggregates.
prerequisites.why: The tracking ID is selected, not applied or confirmed. No Special Link test has been recorded.
